title: Juicy Thai Chicken Salad
description: A rich and light Thai dish featuring Chinese sesame sauce and crispy lardons.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the lardons over medium-high heat until crispy.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool slightly.
Add the cooked chicken to the skillet and toss with the lardons.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Chinese sesame sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, honey, rice vinegar, Thai chilies, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced red onion and red bell pepper to the bowl and toss to combine.
Add the cooked chicken and lardons to the bowl and toss to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, transfer the salad to a serving platter and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
Garnish with additional Thai chilies if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
